issue_context.title: support is_uuid function
issue_context.body:
In the feature request https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/20119 (PR: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/20140 ) 2 helper functions for UUIDs were added: `uuid_to_bin()` and `bin_to_uuid()`.

MySQL 8.0 also added a function `is_uuid()` which is helpful. This is a feature request to track this.
comments:
/assign
I'd like to try on it. I will remove assign if I can't do this.

review_comments:
[`uuid.Parse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/google/uuid@v1.1.2#Parse) accepts input in the form `urn:uuid:*`. So both TiDB's `IS_UUID()` and `UUID_TO_BIN()` are going to recognize this:

```sql
TiDB> select is_uuid('urn:uuid:99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac3');
1
TiDB> select uuid_to_bin('urn:uuid:99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac3');
0x99A9AD03529811EC8F5C00FF90147AC3
```

while MySQL will fail

```sql
TiDB> select is_uuid('urn:uuid:99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac3');
0
TiDB> select uuid_to_bin('urn:uuid:99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac3');
ERROR 1411 (HY000): Incorrect string value: 'urn:uuid:99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac3' for function uuid_to_bin
```

should we keep this incompatibility (since the `UUID_TO_BIN()` behavior has already been part of 5.2.0)

Also it seems that `{99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac30` is wrongly considered as valid UUID due to https://github.com/google/uuid/blob/v1.1.2/uuid.go#L56-L58.
```
mysql> select is_uuid('{99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac30');
1
```
While in MySQL 8.0
```
mysql> select is_uuid('{99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac30');
0
```
Maybe you could add `{99a9ad03-5298-11ec-8f5c-00ff90147ac30` test with some comments.
